title: American pilots trained to fly UFOs despite time displacement

tellings.quote: they conveyed to him that they were training pilots to fly UFOs.

plain: In a deep underground facility in California, American pilots were trained to fly UFOs, though flying them caused a displacement in time. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels this was passed on to Lyn Buchanan, a psychic spy from a US Army program that used mind-reading techniques, by the people running it. If true, the military would already be flying such craft.
